items.why: Fear gauge cooling as CNBC reports the Dow jumping 500 points on solid earnings and falling crude oil, so calm is returning with the rebound.
AI jitters are the story: the Guardian asks if the AI stock market boom is ending, and CNBC notes the AI rally fading away from Wall Street. AI names keep sliding.
Small caps riding the broad rebound, with AP reporting stocks rising after oil prices retreated and companies delivered strong profits.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

summary: Stocks are rebounding Tuesday morning as solid earnings and retreating crude oil stir a broad rally, per CNBC and AP. AI names are still lagging as headlines question whether the AI boom is ending.
